forced.why: Operator decision 2026-10-07: release without the long verification steps. Per check: C06 SOURCE-SIDE - 4 archive pages (/category/our-doctors, /category/our-staff, /category/testimonials, /tag/licansed-by-adobe-stock) carry an empty <title></title> in audit/raw; the rebuild titles them by their h1 (OPEN-DECISIONS A11Y-22, CONTENT-9). C07 SOURCE-SIDE - the one same-origin undownloaded image is the former platform's CSS background https://www.eyecarepro.net/sites/all/themes/ECP/images/review-quote.png, refused HTTP 403 and never retried (skill boundary); a vendor asset the rebuild must not ship (audit/clone-removals.json images.vendorAssets). C17 - sr-parity's word recall (mean 92.9%, 40 majors) counts repeated chrome and declared removals; the project's sentence-level parity gate (tools/run-gates.mjs, control fired) finds 5,426 of 5,617 source sentences with 0 lost. C18 - all 13 description-lost pages are archive pages whose description removal is declared in audit/seo-repairs.json; the project's seo-parity gate reports 0 mismatches. C19 - form-lost counts form elements: the rebuild drops the former platform's WordPress site-search and voice-search forms on every page (declared REMOVE in audit/clone-removals.json; a static build serves no /?s= search) and keeps the real appointment-request and contact forms (inert until the practice supplies an endpoint). C22, C23 UNPROVEN - the screenshot, responsive-sweep and pixel-diff steps were skipped at the operator's request ('the verification and checking process is taking too long'); pixel parity with the source is not the target of a redesign.
